evals.name: git-push-confirm-hook
evals.prompt: I want Claude Code to stop and ask me to confirm before it ever runs `git push` in this repo, but not block other git commands. Write the hook: the .claude/settings.json snippet and the script. Keep it tight.
evals.expected_output: PreToolUse hook on Bash narrowed with if: Bash(git push *), script returning hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision "ask" (not deny / exit 2).

evals.name: release-notes-skill
evals.prompt: make me a personal claude code slash command /release-notes that takes a version (like 2.4.0), reads git log since the previous tag, and writes RELEASE_NOTES.md. I only ever want it to run when I type it, never automatically, and it should do its work in a separate subagent so it doesn't clutter my main context. Just write the file(s).
evals.expected_output: ~/.claude/skills/release-notes/SKILL.md (not commands/), frontmatter disable-model-invocation: true, context: fork, argument handling via $ARGUMENTS/$0/arguments, argument-hint; no version: field.

evals.name: plugin-subagent-mcp
evals.prompt: In my plugin `acme-tools` I'm adding agents/db-auditor.md. It needs its own postgres MCP server (npx @acme/pg-mcp) and should run with permissionMode acceptEdits so it can write reports without prompting. Write the agent file and whatever else is needed.
evals.expected_output: Flags that plugin subagents ignore mcpServers and permissionMode; puts the MCP server in the plugin's .mcp.json (with ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} if paths), and addresses the permission need another way.

evals.name: context-band-mod
evals.prompt: I want to see how full my context window is, always visible right above the prompt in my terminal, updating as Claude works. Build it as something I can load with --plugin-dir. Write all the files.
evals.expected_output: A mod, not a status-line script or settings hook: .claude-plugin/plugin.json (name not starting with claude-), hooks/hooks.json with "modules": ["./register.js"], an ES module exporting register(on). A ui.render hook filtered to { component: 'AbovePrompt' } that gets elements from $.ui.resolve(e), reads $.session.usage().context.percent and keeps other mods' band content via await next(e) (or returns next(e) when there is nothing to show). A redraw via $.ui.invalidate('ui.render') from turn.step/turn.complete. No destructured $, string-literal event names. Mentions claude plugin validate and that it draws only in the terminal/Desktop.

evals.name: force-push-guard-mod
evals.prompt: Write me a Claude Code mod that stops Claude from force-pushing. If my guard code ever crashes I want it to block, not let the push through.
evals.expected_output: tool.call hook with matcher { tool: 'Bash' } returning { deny: <instruction Claude can act on> } without calling next for git push --force / -f / --force-with-lease, next(e) otherwise; a .catch handler on that registration returning { deny } (fail closed, since failed hooks are skipped). Notes that regex on e.command is a reminder not enforcement and suggests a permission deny rule or branch protection for hard enforcement. Optionally a claude-code/testing test.

evals.name: todo-command-mod-with-test
evals.prompt: make a mod that adds /todo add <text> and /todo list. Todos should still be there tomorrow in a different session. include a test I can run in CI.
evals.expected_output: One unfiltered session.start hook calling $.command.register({ name: 'todo', argumentHint, ... }) (last or in try/catch) and returning next(e); command.run hook with { command: 'todo' } returning { text } from e.args; persistence in $.store (not module variables or $.fs), re-reading before set; a tests/*.test.ts importing from 'claude-code/testing' that stubs store.get/store.set with { value } (or mock.store) and runs $.command.run; run with claude plugin test (exits 1 on failure).
